# #1994: Patch: each patch's game figures (who went first and won, how games end, how long they last, fatigue and traps) outlive the week's purge, and /stats shows them
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The server keeps per-card statistics for every patch for good. The figures about whole games are kept only for a week and then lost: how often the player going first wins, how games end, how many turns they last, how often a game reaches fatigue, how often set traps fire. So when the owner weighs a change like the first player's opening hand, no number from people's games older than a week exists. After this the server keeps those figures per patch, and /stats shows a Games panel for the picked patch, for example "first player wins 51% (±3), median 17 turns, 12% of games reach fatigue".

## Why

- Every game record carries `first`, `winner`, `reason` and `turns`, plus R1256000's per-seat counts: fatigue draws and damage, traps set and fired, position switches, Radiant upgrades (`crates/engine/src/wire/stats.rs:113-155`).
- The lasting totals keep none of them.
  - `StatsTotals` holds `records`, `cards` and `lists` only (`stats.rs:619-629`).
  - `record_totals` holds a `records` count (`crates/server/migrations/0041_card_totals.sql:86-98`).
  - A record's detail is purged after `GAME_RECORD_RAW_RETENTION_DAYS = 7` (`crates/server/src/config.rs:259`, R1044001).
- The figures exist only offline: `cargo jackioh stats report --games` (`crates/tools/src/stats.rs:39-44`, `game_report` at `:453`) reads exported files.
- Seat decisions have been made without a figure from people's games.
  - R1156000 raised Player 1's opening draw "for seat balance".
  - `training/README.md:390-393` warns that "the first seat's edge between two AIs is not the people's".
  - The only seat figures checked in are 13 first-seat wins in 40 dev games (`analysis/fixtures/games.report.json`) and 206 of 400 AI games (`training/history/improve-cycle-2026-10-16.md`).

## Proposal

- Add game totals keyed as `RecordsKey` is (patch, source, mode, both pilots):
  - games, first-seat wins and draws;
  - a count per ending and a histogram of turns;
  - R1256000's sums, with the count of records that carry them.
- Fold them in `StatsTotals::fold`, which stays commutative.
- Move `game_report`'s arithmetic into the engine's stats module, so the tool and the server compute one way, as the card figures already do.
- Add a migration for the table (server-only: RLS on, no grant), plus the pg and in-memory stores.
- Add a public cached `GET /api/stats/games?patch=` under R661's provisional gate, and a Games panel on /stats for the picked patch.
- It splits cleanly: the totals, store and route first, the panel second.

## Where it lands

- `crates/engine/src/wire/stats.rs`, `crates/tools/src/stats.rs`
- A new migration in `crates/server/migrations/`; `crates/server/src/db/` (pg and memory), `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`, `crates/server/tests/sql/`
- The server's stats API and router
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` and `apps/web/src/stats/`
- `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.11 and a new ruling; `crates/server/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An engine test: game figures read off totals folded in any order equal `game_report` over the same records, and over `analysis/fixtures` they match `games.report.json`.
- [ ] A store contract test: a live record's game figures read the same after the R1044001 purge empties its detail.
- [ ] An SQL suite check: the new table is server-only.
- [ ] An API test: figures below `PUBLIC_STATS_MIN_LIVE_GAMES` are labelled provisional, and games with a ladder bot are split by pilot pair.
- [ ] A web test: the panel renders, and a short sample reads as not enough games.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.

## Size and risks

Hard (migration, engine, server and web): about 18 files and 900 to 1,300 lines, in two pull requests. Records already folded have no game totals. Only those whose detail is still held can be back-filled, and the panel should say where its figures start.

---

2. Tools delegate (`crates/tools/src/stats.rs`, `arena.rs`). Delete the moved items; `use` the engine's; keep `render_games`, `ReportArgs`, `QUARTERS` only if rendering still needs it (it does not: quartiles arrive computed). `arena.rs` re-exports `jackioh_engine::…::wilson_interval/round_share`. Table `public.game_totals` with the `GameTotals` columns (`reasons`/`turns` jsonb), PK on `(patch, source, mode, p1_pilot, p2_pilot)`, check constraints on source/mode/pilot literals mirroring `record_totals` in `0041_card_totals.sql:86-98`, `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`, no policy, no grant; header comment in 0041's style citing R1994000. Pre-migration folded records contribute nothing: no backfill (their detail predates R1256000 counts or is purged).
4. Store/API tests (`contract.rs`, `tests/api/stats.rs`). Contract: `r1994000_game_figures_read_the_same_after_the_r1044001_purge_empties_detail`, copying `r1044001_…` (contract.rs:5287): insert `mixed_records()`, capture `game_figures_of(&totals)`; age two records 8 days, `purge_expired` with `gameRecordsRecordedBefore: now - 7*DAY`; assert figures unchanged and detail gone; register in `both_stores!`. API: extend `RecordOptions` with `p1_pilot/p2_pilot` (default `"human"`, wired into `make_game_record`'s `pilots`) and add `r1994000_get_api_stats_games_is_provisional_below_1000_live_games` (few records → `source == "provisional"`, label `"AI games + live games (provisional)"`; at/above gate → `"live"`) and `r1994000_get_api_stats_games_splits_a_ladder_bot_game_by_pilot_pair` (`?pilot=human` counts only all-human pairs; merged counts the `(human, ai)` game). 5. Route (`api/stats.rs`, `app.rs`). `get_games`: parse `patch` (default current), `PublicStatsPilot`/`PublicStatsMode` (reuse existing parsers); `totals_for(app, patch, false)`; `live_games = totals.live_games(patch)`; provisional below `PUBLIC_STATS_MIN_LIVE_GAMES` counting `SourceFilter::All`, else `Live` (same gate as `patch_report`); respond `{ patch, liveGames, source, sourceLabel, recordGames: summed records, gameGames: summed game_totals, groups }` via `cached_ok(..., CARD_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS)`; keep per-`ReportKey` in the existing `Kept` infra (add a games cell beside the cards one, same TTL). `recordGames` vs `gameGames` is the panel's coverage note (pre-0062 folds have records but no game rows). Register `("GET", "/api/stats/games", AuthLevel::None, h!(api::stats::get_games))` in `app.rs` with the other stats routes.
6. SQL + pins (`35_game_totals.sql`, `run.sh`, `migrations_pinned.rs`). New suite file headed `\echo '### R1994000: … ###'`: RLS enabled with no policy/grant (query as the suite's client role fails), insert of a bad `source`/`pilot` raises, two upserts add counts in place. Add `0062_game_totals` to `run.sh`'s migration list and the file to its run; add the `PINNED` checksum line (compute via the repo's `checksum` fn).
7. Engine/tools tests. Engine `stats.rs mod tests`: `r1994000_game_figures_off_folded_totals_equal_game_report_in_any_fold_order` — build ~10 records spanning patches/modes/sources/pilots, some without R1256000 counts; fold in three orders with `drills` true and false; for filters across source/mode/patch × pilot human/ai/unified assert `game_figures_of(&totals, f) == game_report(&records, f)`; assert empty totals give empty groups. Tools `stats.rs mod tests`: fixture test asserting `game_report` over the `.jsonl` inputs behind `analysis/fixtures/games.report.json` (confirm which files via `analysis/README.md`; the 40-game `dev` group matches `dev-40.jsonl`-shaped input) serializes to the fixture's groups.
8. Web API + panel (`net/api.ts`, `stats/GamesPanel.tsx`, `testids.ts`, `routes/stats.tsx`). `getGameStats({patch, pilot, mode, signal})` hitting `/api/stats/games` with a `PublicStatsGamesResponse` type mirroring the server body. `GamesPanel({data, loading, error, onRetry})`: header "Games"; first-seat line `First seat wins {share}% (±{half})` (half = `(firstHigh-firstLow)/2`, one decimal); `Median {quartiles[1]} turns`; `{fatigueShare}% reach fatigue`; `Traps: {fired} fired of {set} set`; below `CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE` games (from `stats/config.ts`) show "Not enough games"; footnote `{gameGames} of {recordGames} records carry game figures` when they differ. Add `gamesPanel`/`gamesRetry` testids. In `stats.tsx`, fetch alongside `fetchCardStats` on patch/mode change and render the panel under the summary tiles; reuse the existing provisional banner (R661: no new gate-progress display).
9. Docs + ruling. `spec/rulings/R1994000.md` (front matter `id/title/cards/proven_in` listing the engine test file, contract, API test, `GamesPanel.test.tsx`, SQL file; Hearthstone-semantics sentence per rule 3). Edit §9.11 "The totals" bullet (game totals folded per record, commutative, pre-0062 folds uncovered) and "Public statistics" bullet (`GET /api/stats/games`, gate, pilot split, coverage note); note in `11-rulings.md`; `crates/server/README.md` statistics section; run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules` is untouched; run `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit wire::stats r1994000` (new engine test) and the full `wire::stats` module.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools stats` (delegate + fixture tests).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store store::contract` (contract incl. new purge test) and `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::stats` (new route tests); `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store migrations_pinned`.
- `sh crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh` (needs Docker; CI's db job otherwise).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/GamesPanel.test.tsx` plus the touched route suite `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx`.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Engine figures off totals folded in any order equal `game_report` over the same records, and match `games.report.json` over `analysis/fixtures`.
- [ ] A live record's game figures read the same after the R1044001 purge empties its detail.
- [ ] SQL suite: the new table is server-only (RLS, no grant).
- [ ] API: below `PUBLIC_STATS_MIN_LIVE_GAMES` figures are provisional; ladder-bot games split by pilot pair.
- [ ] Web: Games panel renders; short sample reads "not enough games".
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` green; coverage footnote shown when `gameGames < recordGames`.

## Risks

- Commutativity: reasons/turns histograms merge entrywise and all else sums; `FirstMet`-style ordering state must not leak into `GameTotals` (no tie-breaks stored — quartiles derive from counts alone). The any-order engine test pins this.
- Double counting: `stats_totals_add` early-returns on empty `delta.records`; game totals always ride with a record fold, and pre-0062 rows are covered by the `recordGames/gameGames` gap rather than a backfill that could double-fold.
- Hidden info / client trust (rule 7): the route serves aggregates only, no record ids; the panel reads them like card figures.
- Wire churn: new `ts(export)` types regenerate `apps/web/src/wire/generated/`; commit that diff.

## Open questions

None. All choices are settled above; no person-only step (no dashboard, secret, or forbidden-path change) is needed.
